data.name: Winfield
data.long_meaning: Originally derived from the Old English words ‘wynn’ (friend) and ‘feld’ (open land, field). This name signifies a person who has a strong bond with the land and the people around them. In Christianity, it may symbolize the field of faith and the friend, Jesus Christ, who guides us through our spiritual journey.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of friendship with God and His land.

The name conveys the idea of a strong and loyal individual with a deep connection to the community and the land.
